name: paperfoot
description: Web search for AI agents: the search CLI skill and the metasearch.sh MCP server.

plugins.name: search-cli
plugins.description: Teaches Claude to use the search CLI: auto or explicit modes over ten search engines, page extraction, cost in every result. Needs the search binary (brew install paperfoot/tap/search-cli).

plugins.name: metasearch
plugins.description: The metasearch.sh MCP server: search the web, news, papers, people, places, patents and X posts, and read any page, with a skill for when to search and which mode to ask for. Sign in to metasearch.sh on first use; searches are charged to the organisation you choose.
